cause: Ajv 8.20.0 throws at compile time ('enum must have non-empty array') instead of rejecting every instance.
mitigation: schema lint rejects empty enum in canonical schemas; Ajv fails loudly, never returns a wrong result.

group: properties whose names are Javascript object property names
cause: Ajv 8.20.0 accepts an own '__proto__' data key that violates the property schema (it reads the prototype instead of the own value).
mitigation: schema lint rejects '__proto__' as a property name in canonical schemas; Python backend validation is authoritative.

group: refs with relative uris and defs
cause: Ajv 8.20.0 overflows the stack resolving $ref through a nested $id.
mitigation: schema lint forbids $id below the root, so this pattern cannot occur in canonical schemas.

group: relative refs with absolute uris and defs
cause: Ajv 8.20.0 overflows the stack resolving $ref through a nested $id.
mitigation: schema lint forbids $id below the root.

group: URN ref with nested pointer ref
cause: Ajv 8.20.0 overflows the stack resolving $ref through a nested URN $id.
mitigation: schema lint forbids $id below the root.
